title: booking.v1
description: Messages of the Kafka topic booking.v1: the public state of a booking, without personal data and without the steps of the saga. Conventions are described in contracts/README.md.

booking.state.v1.description: Full state of the key (hotel, booking) with its version. booking publishes it after every change of the booking, channel bookings included.

BookingState.description: Public state of a booking. not_confirmed_reason is present only with the status not_confirmed. The statuses, reasons and refund statuses are the ones of the booking API.

payment_outcome_unresolved.description: True while the booking is not_confirmed and booking does not know whether the money was charged, whatever the reason. The payment reconciliation looks for the outcome of such bookings at the provider; once it reports the outcome, the flag becomes false.
